extracted.intended_audience: conference organizers / program chairs / venue administrators using OpenReview
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedure for running OpenReview's automatic submission→reviewer assignment workflow: ensure submissions are closed, compute affinities/conflicts, run matching, adjust proposals, and deploy assignments for each role group (Senior ACs, ACs, Reviewers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic assignment eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Venues that selected 'Automatic' for 'Submission Reviewer Assignment' in the venue request form will have the option to use automatic assignment by doing the following:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automatic assignment is available only to venues that selected 'Automatic' in their venue request form. Follow the listed steps to use the feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline must have passed
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure your submission deadline has passed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm that the submission period is closed before calculating affinities or running matching; assignments should be run only after submissions are final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calculate affinity scores and conflicts
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculate affinity scores and conflicts using Paper Matching Setup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Paper Matching Setup workflow to compute paper–reviewer affinity scores and to detect conflicts of interest; this is a prerequisite step before running a matching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run a matching
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Execute the matching algorithm/process in the venue UI to produce a proposed set of reviewer/area-chair assignments based on the computed affinities and configured constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modify and finalize proposed assignments
rubrics_metrics.description: Modify and finalize the proposed assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect the proposed assignments and make manual adjustments as needed (e.g., fix conflicts, rebalance loads, respect expertise); finalize the assignment set before deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deploy proposed assignments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish/apply the finalized assignments so they become active for reviewers/area chairs; ensure deployment completes successfully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform the steps for each role group in order
rubrics_metrics.description: You will have to perform all these steps for Senior Area Chairs, then for Area Chairs and Reviewers. Depending on your venue, the names of these groups may vary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run the full pipeline (calculate affinities/conflicts → run matching → modify/finalize → deploy) separately for each hierarchical role group, typically starting with Senior Area Chairs, then Area Chairs, then Reviewers; adapt to your venue's role names.

rubrics_metrics.name: New venue UI: consult workflow assignments section
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using the new venue UI, please refer to the assignments section of the workflow here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users of the new venue UI should follow the assignments section of the venue workflow (linked from the page) for UI-specific steps and guidance rather than this legacy/how-to sequence.
